text:
maria: Heads up — planning to onboard atlasx-4b-v1.2 into model-catalog tomorrow 2026-04-02 09:00 PT. Need canary owner, smoke owner, and rollback lead. ETA ~45m for canary. Ping who is free?

ajay: I can own the canary window (09:00 PT). Will run perf + token-accuracy smoke. @sara can you do the functional/rate-limit smoke?

sara: Yep I can. I'll run end-to-end prompt set + 1000 qps rate-limiter check. Will post results to thread. ETA 35m.

leo: I'll prep the rollback alias and warm previous weights (atlasx-4b-v1.1). If things fail, I can rollback by alias swap (fewer than 5m).

maria: Great. Can we do a 10% canary for 15 mins then 50% for 15? If stable, promote. Also need catalog PR merged before slot opens. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/456

ajay: 10%->50% works. I'll monitor latency, p99, and mem. Quick checks:
- p99 < 420ms
- error rate < 0.5%
- tokens/sec within expected

sara: For functional smoke I'll run sample prompts in `tests/smoke/atlasx` and a small eval harness. If any regression >2% on rouge/bleu we'll abort.

leo: Rollback steps (short):
```
# alias swap
POST /catalog/aliases/swap
{ "from": "atlasx-4b-v1.2", "to": "atlasx-4b-v1.1" }
# confirm routing
curl -s https://api.redwood.example/v1/health || alert
```

deploy-bot: CI — catalog PR passed checks: build ✅ lint ✅ integration-tests ✅

maria: OK, two more asks:
1) ajay — please add the canary metrics dashboard link in the PR description
2) sara — paste the smoke run artifacts (logs/samples) here after smoke

ajay: added dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/atlasx-canary

sara: smoke start 09:02 PT. quick results:
- 2000 samples run
- p95 latency 210ms
- 4 failures (0.2%) — investigating flaky tokenization on a small subset
logs: https://artifacts.redwood/atlasx/20260402/smoke

maria: thanks. leave the canary at 10% for a full 15 min. If no regression, I'll kick promotion at ~09:20 PT.

leo: warming previous model done. standby for alias swap if needed.

ajay: monitoring — p99 creeping to 430ms at tail, but no errors. holding at 10%.

sara: failed samples look like bad prompt formatting; not a model regression. clearing.

maria: promotion approved — moving to 50% now. ajay please watch the dashboards, sara keep smoke verification running.

deploy-bot: rollout event recorded: canary->50% by maria at 3172468200

ajay: all green at 50%. p99 stable ~400ms, error rate 0.18%.

sara: functional checks pass. sample diffs within threshold.

maria: ok final promote to 100% at ~09:40 PT if no surprises. I'll update catalog entry with pinned version and add rollback playbook snippet.

maria: Rollout complete 100% at 3172468289 — no rollback needed :tada:
